column1: # A WRITE to the agent-data SUBTREE, the S1 review's measurement: one touch
# on the node itself and one on a GRANDCHILD three levels below.  Under the
# SUBTREE form ('/fx/disk/agent-data/**') BOTH are covered and both denials
# derive; under a bare directory path the grandchild is covered by NO row
# (exact-only, NEVER a prefix) and no denial derives for it — the silent
# under-protection b5e executes and the subtree form exists to prevent.
